threshold_basis: Separate fixed 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles (R type 7, unrounded) for each attraction. For each existing pooled 2024-2025 month/weather/day-type/hour profile, calculate the mean from known-open, valid hourly observations only, then divide by that attraction's effective area. Closed and unknown opening times, negative and missing counts are excluded; observed zero remains valid. Each finite profile/hour mean has equal weight. Thresholds do not change with UI filters. Original displayed counts remain unchanged.
area_selection_note: All three package scenarios use the same effective area. The 4 m2 row only selects a unique record; no dwell time, simultaneous occupancy or entry conversion is applied.
fallback_basis: None. All thirteen attractions now have area estimates, including the cathedral supplement dated 2026-10-30.
supplementary_area_note: ATTR005 uses City of Melbourne 2020 ground-level building footprint with a 0.5 usable fraction assumption; see cathedral_area_source_2026-10-30.json. It has its own open-hours tercile thresholds, like all other attractions.
tie_policy: Equal intensities receive the same band; exact thirds may differ slightly with ties or indivisible sample sizes. Boundaries belong to the higher band.
